warnings: The set prints NO grid bubbles anywhere — only dimension chains. Labels were assigned following the precedent of houses 122/129 (unlabelled สพฐ. sets): numbers 1-9 on the nine column lines along x (8 bays x 4.00 = 32.00 ม., printed total on the floor plan), letters on the column rows along y with A at the top of the plan as drawn. Origin A1 (top-left).

Rows: A (0.00) and D (14.00) carry the C1 columns (F1C1) on every grid 1-9. B (5.00) and C (9.00) carry the C2 columns (F2C2) on the end walls (grids 1 and 9) and under the stage (grid 2) — all four are column rows, so named. B' (7.00) is the ridge: it carries the T2 ridge girder but no column, so it is a dummy.

Row spacing 5.00 / 4.00 / 5.00: the floor-plan outer chain prints it clearly, the gable-beam detail (sheet 3) prints 5.00 + 2.00 + 2.00 to the ridge, and the roof plan prints 7.00 + 7.00. The structural footing-plan chain is faded: the A-B label is illegible, B-C reads a faint '4.00' and C-D reads '5.?0' (either 5.10 or 5.00 with a broken zero). Measured on the footing plan itself the column rows sit at 4.93 / 4.09 / 4.98 of a nominal 14.00, which does not support 5.10; so 5.00 was taken (two clear sheets + the measured proportion vs one illegible label). Confidence lowered on the file, not on single lines.
The drawing is not to precise scale: A-D measures 13.8-13.9 m against the x scale on the two sheet-2 plans. Every pos_m comes from printed numbers only.

x dummies: 1' (-1.30) is the stage-stair projection printed on the floor plan; 9' (34.00) is the 2.00 annex/canopy (roof plan, floor plan, slab S1 detail); 2' (5.50) is the straight front of the stage between rows B and C, from the ขยายเวที detail (1.50 from the grid-2 beam centre to the front ground beam centre) — the plan itself prints no dimension for it.

y dummies: A' -1.90 / D'' 15.90 roof edge; A'' -1.50 / D' 15.50 walkway edge; A''' 1.00, A'''' 2.00, C' 12.00, C'' 13.00 are the stage-stair ticks of the floor-plan inner chain (the long A''''-C' segment of that chain carries no printed number). Before-origin dummies share A's prime sequence (A', A'' then A''', A'''' in the A-B gap).

Truss panel chains (T1 0.95+0.95 then 1.00 panels to the ridge, T2 1.00 x 4) and the eave-cladding / fin / footing-layer dimensions were treated as member-internal (section 4 rule 4 exception: a dimension inside one element's own detail) and put in unassigned_dimensions, not turned into grid lines.

Dimension sweep covers sheet 1 (page 02: floor plan and section ก-ก; the three elevations print no dimension rows), sheet 2 (page 03: both plans and all details) and sheet 3 (page 04: T1/T2 trusses, gable beam B, notes). Page 05 is a furniture (ครุภัณฑ์) sheet from a different year's set and was not swept. Page 01 is the sharer's cover.
